def: A unit of land area the size of a tsubo, about 3.3 square meters; the cadastres give homestead lots in bu. Written after another unit, as in 57 tsubo 2 bu 5 rin, it means a tenth of that unit; in silver, a tenth of a monme, as in 4 monme 2 bu or 9 bu a mat. In money it is a gold coin, a quarter of a ryo, as in 11 ryo 2 bu.
